token_accounting.sample_unit: one replay from one player perspective
token_accounting.entity: one token per entity instance with a non-null attribute at a timestep
token_accounting.upgrade: one token per listed cumulative upgrade at a timestep
token_accounting.pretrain_input: all self tokens plus all zero-fog enemy tokens, interleaved per timestep ([self][enemy] per timestep) with exactly one delimiter per timestep and one terminal [EOS]
token_accounting.finetune_input: all self tokens plus all zero-fog enemy tokens, interleaved per timestep ([self][enemy] per timestep) with exactly one delimiter per timestep and one terminal [EOS]
token_accounting.output: one [BOS] token, one perspective outcome token, all enemy tokens, one delimiter per timestep, and one terminal [END] token
